How CPU bins are calculated

Effective CPUs = max(requested CPUs, ceil(total requested memory / 3.75 GiB)). Slurm per-CPU and per-node memory requests are expanded to the job total. Missing memory requests use requested CPUs. Bins include both displayed bounds; blank cells have no matching jobs. Wait = start − submission.
